verdict.rationale: Checkout.com's own issuing product supports physical cards with branded card design, materials and carriers. It states "we'll handle physical cards," which covers not having to manage a manufacturer yourself. The evidence does not show that physical cards can be ordered through the API, and it says nothing about bulk orders, shipping methods or delivery tracking. Missing for 10: documented API endpoint for ordering physical cards, bulk ordering, shipping method selection, shipment tracking, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can order personalized physical cards through the API — custom card art, bulk orders, shipping methods and tracking — without managing a card manufacturer relationship myself

citations.quote: Deliver virtual cards instantly and we’ll handle physical cards.
Attract attention with branded card design, eco-friendly card materials, and innovative card carriers.
Tailor card designs, usage profiles, and authorization flows
Our platform supports physical cards and single or multi-use virtual cards
